varieties.name: Managu (Solanum scabrum)
varieties.supplier_notes: Local Kenyan managu; broad leaves; main commercial type.

varieties.name: Olevu (S. villosum)
varieties.supplier_notes: Smaller leaves but tastier; village-market preferred.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow in raised nursery bed at 1cm depth. Tiny seed — barely cover.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda kitalu kina 1cm. Mbegu ndogo — funika kidogo sana.
Weka kilo 50 za CAN. Huongeza majani.

timeline_template.description_en: Pluck top 2-3 leaves and tender stems. Don't strip the whole plant.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chuna majani 2-3 ya juu na shina laini. Usimaliz e mmea wote.
timeline_template.tip_en: First harvest delayed = sweeter taste, less bitter compounds.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Mavuno ya kwanza ukichelewa = ladha tamu zaidi.

timeline_template.description_en: Continue plucking every 7-10 days for 3 months.
timeline_template.description_sw: Endelea kuchuna kila siku 7-10 kwa miezi 3.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Bunched leaves + tender stems. Reject yellowed or seeded shoots.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: Tied bunches ~200g, sold same-day at market.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sell same-day. Cool 5-10°C if delay forced.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; honeydew on leaves; check undersides of young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; utomvu majani; chunguza chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Weekly underside scouting, natural enemies first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Fine pale stippling, leaf bronzing, fine webbing on undersides in hot-dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa madogo ya rangi, majani kuwa shaba, utando mwembamba chini joto-kavu.
diseases.treatment_en: Abamectin-class miticide at first webbing; repeat in 7 days. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa ya utitiri ya abamectin mara utando unapoanza; rudia baada ya siku 7. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Avoid water stress, mist leaves, natural predators first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Epuka mkazo wa maji, nyunyizia majani, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Tap a leaf over white paper — moving specks confirm mites.

diseases.symptoms_en: Target-ring brown spots on older leaves first, yellowing, dieback.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa ya kahawia yenye pete kwenye majani makubwa kwanza, kuwitikia.
diseases.treatment_en: Mancozeb-class or copper alternation every 7-10 days from first sign. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za mancozeb au copper kwa kubadilishana kila siku 7-10. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha, nafasi ya kutosha, epuka kumwagilia jioni.
diseases.scanner_notes: Ringed spots on older leaves; no white fuzz (vs late blight).

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Traditional staple demand is constant; weekly cuts of young shoots. Same-day selling.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mahitaji ya kiasili ni ya kudumu; vuna machipukizi kila wiki. Uza siku hiyohiyo.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 20–50 KES per kg retail (November 2026). The demand never pauses — the crop that pays like a salary.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 20–50 kwa kilo rejareja (Novemba 2026). Mahitaji hayapumziki.
